name: elevenlabs
summary: Successfully completed the ElevenLabs quickstart end-to-end. Installed the elevenlabs SDK and python-dotenv, created the example script, and ran it. The text-to-speech API successfully generated a valid MP3 audio file (41,839 bytes) from the input text "The first move is what sets everything in motion." The file was verified as a real MPEG ADTS Layer III audio file at 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, monaural.
deviations: The quickstart's example code uses `from elevenlabs.play import play` and `play(audio)` to play audio through speakers. Since the sandbox has no audio output hardware, I deviated by saving the audio stream to a file (`/home/daytona/output.mp3`) and verifying its content and format with the `file` command. This is the only deviation — all other steps (SDK installation, API authentication, text-to-speech request with the same voice_id, model_id, and output_format) followed the quickstart exactly.
